chapter_title: [Concer]ning why, if the Person shall look down in
spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation


**
¶1.
**
 Inst
ruct me concerning
 this truth
: When the mind
 stands
 above natural
 truth
 and dir
ects its
 understanding down
ward into that
 truth
, if
 one
 perce
ives there
 the reflection
 of one
's own interior character, why
 does
 what
 is highest
 in the
 person
 —
 understanding
 and
 wisdom — appear as
 what
 is lowest, and what is lowest —
 the
 ou
termost natural
 life —
 appear
 as what is uppermost? For
 when
 spiritual realities are perceived through natural
 truth alone
, the divine order is
 seen
 in
 complete
 in
version:
 the
 inmost appears
 outermost, and the
 outermost appears in
most. And
 further
:
 when one fixes
 the
 mind only
 down
ward into
 natural truth
, one's
 own interior quality becomes
 altogether
 invisible — one
 cannot
 perce
ive it
 there
 at all.
 The spiritual character
 of
 a person cannot
 be seen by
 an
 understanding
 that is wholly
 imm
ersed in natural knowledge
.

**¶3.**
 The interior
 character of
 a person and the forms
 of perception
 appear
 inverted when
 reflected
 in natural truth,
 and
 this signifies the mystery of the divine
 calling
 —
 the summons of
 wisdom
 —
 when it was sent down
ward into
 the realms of falsity toward the
 primordial celest
ial human. For
 the divine call cast
 itself head
long into those
 lower states of the mind, plun
ging into
 natural
 truth as
 one
 who throws
 himself
 into
 water
,
 inverting its
 own heav
enly order so
 that
 it
 might reach what had descended
 into darkness.
 It
 descended into the lowest
 regions
 of the mind with power and with
 ard
ent
 purpose
.


**¶4.** And
 when
 the
 person lifts the
 understanding upward out
 of natural truth, the
 interior character is no longer visible in that
 truth
,
 because
 the mind is now directed above. This
 sign
ifies the responsive will
 —
 the answ
ering love
 — that ascended from the lower states
 of the mind, rising
 from
 the primordial human up
ward to the Divine
 Proceeding Life
. For
 when
 aff
ection
 answers
 the divine
 call and
 rises,
 it no
 longer appears
 reflected
 in natural
 truth;
 it
 has
 passed
 beyond
 what
 natural
 knowledge
 can mirror
.
 This
 is a spiritual reality revealed
 so
 that you may
 compreh
end it.

**¶5
.** If
 you wish to understand yet
 another mystery
 in
 out
ward form concerning
 this subject, attend
 and I will
 open
 it.
 The interior
 qualities of people
, the
 living
 affections within
 them, and all
 their
 perceptions of
 truth
 appear inverted when seen through natural truth
. This corresponds to how the
 spiritual knowledges and the entire
 order of divine
 providence —
 the governing
 con
stellations of
 wisdom
 in
 the heavens of
 the mind — hang
 inverted and
 are
 visible in the vast
 gathering
 of natural knowledge.
 For the interior character
 of people,
 their affections, and all their per
ceptions of
 truth depend from
 those
 spiritual knowledges above
 and from that divine ordering,
 having
 been
 beg
otten from them. Just as those orig
inating principles
,
 spread out in the higher
 degrees
 of the mind
, appear inverted when perceived
 from below — so it
 is that whenever
 people direct their understanding downward into natural
 truth, the mystery of their spiritual origins
 is disclosed
 to them, but in reversed
 form.
 This is why
 you will always
 find their
 forms
 inv
erted:
 because
 what
 desc
ends from
 heaven
 into the natural
 mind
 necessarily
 rever
ses its
 order
 in
 the descent
.

**¶6.**
 Nor
 is
 this all
. Consider
 the one
 who
 is born an
ew in
 spirit
:
 as the hour of
 regener
ation approaches
, the person is inverted —
 what is
 in
most and highest,
 the
 first
 principle
 of love
 and wisdom, descends first into natural
 life. One enters
 new spiritual life through
 what
 is highest
,
 as
 a
 child is
 born head
 first.
 The
 inmost
 things of the
 will
 and
 understanding
 enter the natural degree before
 the rest
 follows
. And
 this
 mystery
 of
 regener
ation is what
 is disclosed
 whenever one contemplates one
's nature
 reflected
 in natural truth —
 the in
version reveals
 that
 new
 life
 must
 begin
 from
 above
, desc
ending into what
 is
 below.

**¶7.
** Furthermore, I reveal this
:
 the
 corpor
eal and
 sens
ory appearance
 of the person
 — the shadow of
 the natural
 mind — is always joined to the external
 natural degree
 and
 never
 separ
ates from it. However
 the
 person
 may
 be
 troubled or
 elevated
 in spirit
, this
 natural
 shadow
 remains bound
 to the ou
termost level
 and
 cannot be lifted
 from
 it. This is a great sign,
 signifying that the entire corpor
eal nature
 originated
 from the external natural degree and ascended
 from the deepest sens
ory states — from the abyss
 of merely
 bod
ily consciousness. And
 because
 of
 this origin
, the shadow of
 the natural
 self
 is forever
 joined to the earth, directed
 downward, hanging
 as
 an ou
termost projection from the
 spiritual reality above —
 dependent
 entirely upon
 what is interior
, yet
 always turned
 toward what is beneath
.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: instruct me about this lesson: When the person is above water and looking down [into the wat]ers, if he shall see his face reflected why shall you find his head turned upside down and also his feet upwards? Yet, when he stares down into the waters, his face shall not be visible, nor can he see it there?

[And] this: The face of people and the shape of trees shall appear turned upside down in the water as this is signified in [the] mystery of the summons, when it was sent down to the worlds of darkness towards the First Man. Sin[ce the summons was sent down to the darkness,] in this way it cast itself down [into the deep,] like a person [who] plunges headlong into water; so it is also with the summons. It cast itself headlong to the worlds below, with strength and diligence.

And this too: Shall the person lift his head up from the water, his face shall not be visible to him, being bent below. This characterises the mystery of the obedience that ascended from below, from with the First Man his father to the Living Spirit. This is a spiritual mystery that I have [revea]led to you so that you would understand it.

If you wish to understand another corporeal mystery on this subject, listen and I may teach you to understand it. The face of people and of animals and of trees is visible in the water, hanging upside down. This occurs to the mystery of the stars and the zodiac, which hang upside down and are visible in the great sea. For the face of people and beasts and all trees hang on the root of the stars and the zodiac, being begotten from them. Just as their fathers, who are spread out above, hang upside down; so it is also that the mystery of their fathers is being revealed to them whenever they stare down into the water. This is, that you shall find their shapes inverted.

Not only this, but [the] child who is born; as the ho[ur] approaches for him to be born, he hangs upside down and is born head first. Indeed, due to this, his mystery shall be revealed in these waters people stare down into.

Furthermore, I reveal something else to you: Behold, you will find the shadow of the person who walks along is joined to the earth all the time. If the person is troubled [...] his shadow up upon the earth [...] above. It is impossible for him to do [... ...] on the earth. See, this mystery is [a] great sign, signifying that the entire body came from the earth and had ascended from the abyss. Again, due to this, its shadow is joined on the earth, turned downwards, and hanging from above.
